additional_conditions.feature_timestamp: completed signal close; never entry day or later
additional_conditions.liquidity_trap_guard: one-price limit-down count in 20 completed pre-signal sessions <= 1

economic_hypothesis: One isolated limit-down can be capitulation, but repeated one-price limit-downs in the preceding month indicate rationed liquidity: apparent low turnover is not supply exhaustion because holders could not sell. Demand-recapture entries are admitted only after this liquidity-trap pattern is absent and the issuer is known non-ST at the completed signal close.

unchanged_v27.entry: first legal buyable 1-minute open after signal
unchanged_v27.trigger: first completed daily close above previous completed daily high
